title: New IK nodes are not properly omitted from builds with physics disabled
body:
### Tested versions

This is a regression from -dev3 to -dev4.

### System information

Godot v4.6.dev4 - Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS 24.04 on Tty - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - (software emulation on CPU) llvmpipe (LLVM 20.1.2, 256 bits) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13700 (24 threads) - 61.26 GiB memory

### Steps to reproduce

Here's my script (with `../../../godot` being a git clone of the 4.6-dev4 commit)
```
#!/bin/bash -e

cd ../../../godot

# increase the stack size and initial memory for web export template
# enable debug symbols in both release and debug
# disable a bunch of stuff we don't use to save file size
for target in template_release template_debug; do
	scons \
		platform=web \
		target="$target" \
		threads=yes \
		dev_build=no \
		production=yes \
		lto=thin \
		dlink_enabled=yes \
		debug_symbols=yes \
		initial_memory=64 \
		stack_size=16384 \
		disable_physics_2d=yes \
		disable_physics_3d=yes \
		disable_navigation_2d=yes \
		disable_navigation_3d=yes \
		disable_xr=yes
done
```
